connectorUiConfig.title: GitGuardian Enterprise (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The GitGuardian Enterprise data connector ingests secret incidents and workspace audit logs into Microsoft Sentinel by using the GitGuardian API. Secret incidents provide visibility into exposed secrets and their remediation lifecycle. Audit logs record administrative and user activity in the GitGuardian workspace.

This connector supports the GitGuardian SaaS US and EU regions.

sampleQueries.query:
GitGuardianSecretIncidents_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

GitGuardianSecretIncidents_CL
| where Status == "TRIGGERED"
| summarize IncidentCount = count() by Severity
| sort by IncidentCount desc

GitGuardianAuditLogs_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

GitGuardianAuditLogs_CL
| summarize EventCount = count() by EventName, ActionType
| sort by EventCount desc

dataTypes.name: GitGuardianSecretIncidents_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
GitGuardianSecretIncidents_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: GitGuardianAuditLogs_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
GitGuardianAuditLogs_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value: union GitGuardianSecretIncidents_CL, GitGuardianAuditLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | take 1

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: GitGuardian Enterprise workspace
customs.description: An active GitGuardian Enterprise workspace in the US or EU SaaS region is required.

customs.name: GitGuardian API token
customs.description: A GitGuardian service account token with the `incidents:read` and `audit_logs:read` scopes is required.

instructionSteps.title: Create a GitGuardian service account token
instructionSteps.description:
1. In GitGuardian, create a service account for Microsoft Sentinel.
2. Grant the service account the `incidents:read` and `audit_logs:read` scopes.
3. Create and securely copy its API token.

For more information, see the [GitGuardian API authentication documentation](https://docs.gitguardian.com/api-docs/authentication).

instructionSteps.title: Connect GitGuardian Enterprise
instructionSteps.description: Select the GitGuardian SaaS region and enter the service account token.
